INSECT PROTEIN · SERBIA

The future of protein.Built for industry.

Industrial insect protein production in Sombor, Serbia. The site and factory building are available; larvae supply and offtake are covered by contractual arrangements.

Explore the project↗ Start a conversation↗

Preparing for production start-up

01 / COMPANY

Concrete foundations for implementation.

The site and factory building in Sombor are available. Young larvae supply and product offtake are covered by contractual arrangements. According to management, supply and offtake have been agreed for ten years.

Martin Holzer and Andria Mitić contribute their experience, materials, installation work and personal involvement. They will manage the factory and personally organise and oversee production operations.

  • LocationExisting factory building in Sombor
  • Contractual frameworkTen years according to management
  • OperationsMartin Holzer and Andria Mitić

02 / PRODUCTION APPROACH

Biological processes. Industrial planning.

The project centres on rearing black soldier fly larvae. Supply, production processes and subsequent offtake are being prepared as a connected operation.

01

Supply

Contractually arranged supply of young larvae for the planned production process.

02

Rearing and quality

Preparing technical operating conditions and procedures for hygiene, quality and traceability.

03

Offtake and logistics

A contractual framework for offtake of products meeting specifications, as well as delivery and transport.

Our contribution to infrastructure and operations

Martin Holzer and Andria Mitić will contribute solar power, climate control, ventilation and water-treatment systems, including materials and installation. The energy concept aims to enable operation independent of the public electricity grid.

03 / PLANNED PRODUCTS

Raw materials for further value creation.

Preparing for production start-up

01

Reared larvae

The planned operation will rear black soldier fly larvae to produce larval biomass for further processing.

02

Insect frass

Insect frass is planned as a second product from the production process. Its subsequent use will depend on the relevant quality, processing and legal requirements.

Product forms and applications will depend on technical design, quality requirements and the applicable legal conditions.

04 / PARTNERSHIPS

Long-term partnerships start with a conversation.

Building on the available site and contractual arrangements, we welcome discussions with selected investors and strategic partners for the next stage of implementation.

Our own contribution includes technical infrastructure, installation work and future operational management. Further information is shared through direct discussions and agreed confidentiality arrangements.
